data.title: CEO and VA Employee Sentenced for Paying and Receiving Illegal Health Care Kickbacks and Bribes
data.summary: Two Florida men were sentenced today for their roles in a conspiracy to pay and receive illegal health care kickbacks. Laurent Cassagnol was sentenced to 6 months in prison, and Heriberto Rivera was sentenced to 13 months in prison. In addition to the prison terms, Cassagnol was ordered to forfeit $175,172, and Rivera was ordered to forfeit $515,542, which represented the proceeds that the defendants obtained from the offense.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/ceo-and-v.label: CEO and VA Employee Sentenced for Paying and Receiving Illegal Health Care Kickbacks and Bribes

data.title: Justice Department Says Federal Education Aid Cannot Be Tied to Unconstitutional Race-Based Criteria
data.summary: Today, the Department of Justice’s Office of Legal Counsel issued an opinion clarifying the limits on the Department of Education’s authority to consider race when administering the Magnet Schools Assistance Program (MSAP). MSAP is a federal grant program designed to promote voluntary school desegregation and expand educational opportunities for students through competitive grants to school districts. The opinion reaffirms the federal government’s longstanding support for magnet schools while ensuring that federal assistance is not conditioned on unconstitutional race‑based criteria.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/justice-d.label: Justice Department Says Federal Education Aid Cannot Be Tied to Unconstitutional Race-Based Criteria

data.title: Reward Offers Up to $50M for Information Leading to Arrests and/or Convictions of Foreign Terrorist Organization Tren de Aragua (TdA) Leaders Following Homeland Security Task Force Investigation
data.summary: Note : Read the Superseding Indictment here. Foreign Terrorist Organization Tren de Aragua (TdA) leaders Yohan José Romero, also known as “Yohan Petrica,” 48; Giovanni Vicente Mosquera Serrano, also known as “El Viejo,” 37; and Juan Gabriel Rivas Núñez, also known as “Juancho,” 44, were previously charged in a 2025 six-count second superseding indictment in the Southern District of Texas, for conspiring to provide and providing material support to TdA. data.title: 14 Charged in Deadly Human Smuggling Scheme That Killed 7 Aliens Earlier This Year
data.summary: A federal grand jury in the Western District of Texas returned a superseding indictment charging a total of 14 individuals, including seven illegal aliens, three non-citizens, and four U.S. citizens, for their roles in a conspiracy to smuggle aliens into the United States for profit. This included a failed human smuggling event that resulted in the deaths of seven people, including one child, who died after being loaded into a poorly ventilated shipping container.

data.title: Justice Department Sues Lyft for Denying Rides to Passengers with Service Dogs, Wheelchairs
data.summary: Today, the Justice Department (Department) filed a lawsuit against Lyft Inc., for discriminating against passengers with disabilities, including those who use service animals and mobility devices such as stowable wheelchairs. Lyft provides an important transportation option for millions of people throughout the United States. The lawsuit seeks $53 million for individuals with disabilities who Lyft has discriminated against, and who have submitted complaints to Lyft or the Department.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/justice-d.label: Justice Department Sues Lyft for Denying Rides to Passengers with Service Dogs, Wheelchairs

data.title: Arizona Federal Court Denies Request to Halt Hermosa Critical Minerals Project
data.summary: The U.S. District Court for the District of Arizona last week denied a motion for a preliminary injunction to halt construction of the Hermosa Critical Minerals Project in southeastern Arizona. The project will establish a domestic source of manganese and substantially increase domestic production of zinc, which are essential to the steel used in military vehicles and naval vessels. In battery-grade form, manganese is also essential to the advanced lithium-ion batteries that power unmanned aerial vehicles, radios, and other defense equipment. The United States relies entirely on imports of manganese and almost entirely on imports of zinc, with China providing about 95% of global refining capacity for manganese used in advanced batteries.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/arizona-f.label: Arizona Federal Court Denies Request to Halt Hermosa Critical Minerals Project

data.title: Three Iranian-Backed Operatives Indicted for Their Roles in Nearly 20 Terrorist Attacks and Attempted Attacks Across Europe and the United States
data.summary: An eight-count superseding indictment was unsealed today charging Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi, a dual Iranian-Iraqi national; Mohsen Mohajeri, an Iranian national; and Mohammad Ali al-Hassani, an Iraqi national, with terrorism-related offenses for their activities in support of Kata’ib Hizballah and Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), two U.S. designated foreign terrorist organizations (FTOs), including their involvement in nearly 20 attacks and attempted attacks throughout Europe and the United States, and a September 2026 terrorist plot at a British Royal Air Force Base in Fairford, United Kingdom, where American armed forces were stationed.

data.title: Court Orders Atlanta Area Tax Return Preparer to Permanently Shut Down Tax Preparation Business
data.summary: The U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia issued a permanent injunction against tax return preparer Tanja D. Hollis, of Griffin, Georgia, and Hollis’s business, Tanja Tax Preparations, LLC. The injunction bars Hollis from acting as a return preparer, preparing tax returns or assisting others in the preparation of tax returns, engaging in conduct that substantially interferes with the proper administration and enforcement of the internal revenue laws and from promoting any false tax scheme.

https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/court-ord.label: Court Orders Atlanta Area Tax Return Preparer to Permanently Shut Down Tax Preparation Business
